candidates.change_summary: Replace the assignment to balances[owner] so NETM sets the deployer balance to totalSupply instead of totalDistributed, which changes balances observed after NETM.
Remove the line that decreases allowed[_from][msg.sender], so allowances are not reduced by transferFrom.
Replace the allowance decrement with an increment, so allowed[_from][msg.sender] increases by _amount after transferFrom.
Move the allowance decrement to after the return (dead code), so allowed is not changed when transferFrom returns.
